overrides_used.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-04, accession 0001287750-26-000006), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and Note 9 (Stockholders' Equity): no share-based/stock-based compensation line or adjustment appears among the operating adjustments, the filing contains no equity-incentive or stock-compensation note, and Note 9 reports stock issued only by sale (ATM offerings — 42.4M shares for $937.2M gross proceeds in 2025) and, in 2024, on conversion of the 2024 convertible notes — no stock grants to anyone, including non-employee directors, and no stock-compensation expense amount is reported anywhere in the filing.

Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-04, accession 0001287750-26-000006), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: the statement has only OPERATING ACTIVITIES and FINANCING ACTIVITIES sections (no investing-activities section exists), no purchases-of-property-and-equipment or capital-expenditures line appears anywhere in it, and the FY2025 totals reconcile exactly with no investing section — operating $(1,717)M + financing $1,781M = the reported $64M change in cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash (beginning $860M, ending $924M), with no FX line.
